settings.title: Settings
settings.contentLocaleDesc: Default language for AI-generated quizzes and content. You can still override it on any specific quiz.
settings.sioDesc: Connect your Systeme.io account to sync leads automatically. Find your API key in Systeme.io > Settings > API.
settings.subtitle: Configure your account and preferences
settings.identityDesc: Your first and last name, used across the app. Fix them here if needed.
settings.audienceDesc: Describe your audience - pre-filled when creating quizzes with AI
settings.audiencePh: e.g. I help freelance designers land high-paying clients
settings.privacyDesc: Default URL used in your quizzes
settings.logoDesc: Upload your logo or paste a URL
settings.faviconDesc: Upload your favicon (shown in the browser tab on your custom domain). Square image, 256×256 px recommended.
settings.websiteDesc: URL of your site (shown in quizzes)
settings.autoDesc: Once a lead is captured by your quiz, Tiquiz puts a tag on the contact in Systeme.io. That tag can trigger an automation - campaign signup, course access, community add, etc. Everything is configured in Systeme.io, no code needed.
settings.autoStep1Title: Create your tags in Systeme.io before building your quiz
settings.autoStep1P1: In Systeme.io > Contacts > Tags, create one tag per quiz result you want to automate. Examples: quiz-visionary, quiz-strategist, quiz-share (for participants who share).
settings.autoStep1P2: Then, when building your quiz in Tiquiz, link these tags to each of your results from the Systeme.io tab.
settings.autoSurveyNote: Running a survey instead? Surveys have no results, so there's a single tag: set it in the survey's contact form (the « Lead tag » field). It's applied to everyone who submits. Steps 2 and 3 work exactly the same.
settings.autoStep2P1: In Systeme.io > Automations > Rules, click Create a rule.
settings.autoStep2Trigger: Trigger: "Tag added to a contact" → pick your tag (e.g. quiz-visionary)
settings.autoStep2Actions: Actions (chain as many as you want):
settings.autoStep2A1: Subscribe to an email campaign (onboarding sequence, newsletter…)
settings.autoStep2A2: Grant access to a course in your Systeme.io school
settings.autoStep2A4: Send a one-off email (welcome, bonus, etc.)
settings.autoStep2A5: Add another tag, fire a webhook, etc.
settings.autoStep3Title: What happens when a lead answers
settings.autoStep3P: The participant enters their email → Tiquiz creates (or updates) the contact in Systeme.io and puts the tag matching their result. Systeme.io detects the tag and triggers every action in your rule. Zero clicks on your end.
settings.autoTestTitle: Important when you test your quiz
settings.autoTestP: Systeme.io will not re-trigger an automation if the tag is already on your test email. Before each new test, go to Contacts, open your test contact, and manually remove the tag - otherwise you'll see your contact in Systeme.io but the rule won't fire and you'll think it's broken.
settings.confirmCancelSub: Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription? You'll go back to the free plan (1 quiz + 1 survey + 1 popquiz, 10 responses/month).
settings.cancelInstructions: To cancel, contact us at hello@ethilife.fr or manage your subscription from Systeme.io.
settings.lifetimeNote: You have lifetime access to every Pro feature. No renewal, no charge.
settings.cancelRequested: Cancellation registered. You keep access until the end of your current billing period.
settings.cancelError: Could not cancel. Try again or contact hello@ethilife.fr.

settings.deleteAccountDesc: Deletes all your data, quizzes and leads
settings.confirmDeleteAccount: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action is irreversible.
settings.customDomainsDesc: Use a branded URL like quiz.your-business.com instead of the default Tiquiz address. Your quizzes load on your own domain.
settings.customDomainsEmpty: No domain connected yet. Add one to start using your own URL.
settings.customDomainsUpsellTitle: Custom domains are a Pro feature
settings.customDomainsUpsellDesc: Upgrade your plan to connect your own domain and serve your quizzes from a branded URL.
settings.domainAddDesc: We'll guide you through pointing your domain at Tiquiz step by step.
settings.domainDeleteDesc: Visitors of {hostname} will stop reaching your Tiquiz space. You can re-add it any time.
settings.domainHostnameHint: Use a subdomain you control (recommended) or your apex domain. Anything you can edit DNS for.
settings.domainPendingHint: Add the DNS record below, then we'll detect it automatically.
settings.domainPollingExhausted: DNS hasn't propagated yet. Click Check again when ready.

cloudflare.s1: Open the DNS tab of {root} in your Cloudflare dashboard.
cloudflare.s3: Pick CNAME, set Name to "{name}" and Target to "{cnameTarget}".
cloudflare.s4: IMPORTANT: switch Proxy status to "DNS only" (gray cloud), then save.

ovh.s1: Open the OVH manager, go to your domain {root}, then the DNS zone tab.
ovh.s2: Click "Add an entry" and choose CNAME.
ovh.s3: Set the sub-domain to "{name}" and the target to "{cnameTarget}." (with the trailing dot).
ovh.s4: Validate and wait a few minutes for propagation.

godaddy.s1: Open the GoDaddy DNS Management page for {root}.
godaddy.s3: Type = CNAME, Name = "{name}", Value = "{cnameTarget}", TTL = 1 Hour.

namecheap.s2: Click "Add New Record" and choose "CNAME Record".
namecheap.s4: Click the green check to save.

gandi.s1: Open your Gandi DNS records page for {root}.
gandi.s3: Type CNAME, Name = "{name}", Hostname = "{cnameTarget}." (with the trailing dot).

google.s2: Add a new custom resource record.

generic.s1: Open the DNS management for {root} in your registrar's dashboard.
generic.s2: Find the option to add a new DNS record.
generic.s3: Create a CNAME with Name = "{name}" and Target/Value = "{cnameTarget}".
generic.s4: Save the record. We'll detect the change automatically.

settings.trackingDefaultsMetaCapiHelp: Enables server-side conversion sending (bypasses ad blockers, improves matching, deduplicated with the pixel). Events Manager → your dataset → Settings → Conversions API → "Generate an access token". Use alongside the pixel above.
settings.affiliateWhereId: Where do I find my ID? Sign in to Systeme.io → Affiliate dashboard → in the top-right you'll see your affiliate ID (it starts with sa). Copy it, paste it here, done.
settings.affiliateEmptyFieldNote: Leave this field empty and the footer stays visible without tracking - sign-ups won't earn you anything.

settings.affCommDesc: On every published quiz, the footer "This quiz is powered by Tiquiz" links to the Tiquiz presentation page. If you paste your Systeme.io affiliate ID below, every sign-up that results earns you a commission, automatically.

helpSeo.metaTitle: Index my quizzes on Google - Tiquiz Help
helpSeo.metaDescription: How to make your quizzes visible on Google Search, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other search engines / AI tools. Step-by-step guide.
helpSeo.title: Index my quizzes on Google and AI tools
helpSeo.subtitle: Make your quizzes appear in Google Search, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude search - 5 to 10 minutes of setup, then it's automatic.

s1.heading: Why index?
s1.body1: When Google or an AI indexes your quiz, anyone can find it by searching your topic. Three concrete benefits:
s1.li1: Free recurring traffic from Google Search - every relevant search is a chance to capture a lead.
s1.li2: When someone asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Claude "recommend me a quiz about X", your quiz can be surfaced.
s1.li3: More social shares: visitors who find you through search often share to their network.

s2.heading: Step 1 - Submit your sitemap to Google
s2.body1: Google needs a "sitemap" (list of your quizzes) to index them. Tiquiz generates it automatically.
s2.li1: Go to Google Search Console: https://search.google.com/search-console
s2.li2: Click "Add a property" and enter your domain (e.g. tiquiz.com OR your custom domain if you have one).
s2.li3: Verify ownership (via DNS TXT record - Google walks you through).
s2.li4: In the left menu, go to "Sitemaps" and enter: sitemap.xml
s2.li5: Click "Submit". Google will crawl your quizzes within 1 to 7 days.
s2.note: You don't need to re-submit for each new quiz - the sitemap is regenerated automatically every hour.

s3.heading: Step 2 - With a custom domain
s3.body1: If you have a custom domain (e.g. quiz.yoursite.com), you can index your quizzes on YOUR domain instead of tiquiz.com. More powerful for your SEO.
s3.li1: Add your custom domain to Google Search Console as a "domain property".
s3.li2: Verify ownership via a DNS TXT record (Google gives you the value to paste).
s3.li3: Submit the sitemap: https://your-domain.com/sitemap.xml - it will list ONLY your quizzes, on YOUR URL.

s4.heading: Step 3 - Optimize each quiz for SEO
s4.body1: The better your quiz is titled and described, the more Google and AI will surface it. Best practices:
s4.li1Body: It's the text Google shows in results. Include your main keyword.
s4.li2Title: Description ("Social preview" field in the editor)
s4.li2Body: 150-160 characters summarizing the quiz value and encouraging clicks.
s4.li3Body: Not "quiz1" but "nervous-system-profile" or "fine-art-photo-style". The slug is your URL.
s4.li4Body: Appears on Google Images and iMessage / WhatsApp previews. A great image = +20-30% clicks.

s5.heading: Step 4 - Visibility on AI (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude)
s5.body1: You have nothing extra to set up. AIs automatically crawl sites via our `llms.txt` file (a manifest we generate for you) which lists your quizzes, their description and URL in a format optimized for LLMs.
s5.note: The more you fill in the title, description and OG image in the editor, the more precisely an AI can recommend your quiz to the right users.

s6.heading: Step 5 - Hide a quiz from search engines
s6.body1: If you want to keep a quiz private (link-only, no risk of it appearing in Google), check the box "Hide this quiz from search engines" in the SEO tab of the quiz editor.
s6.body2: The quiz stays active and shareable via its direct link, but is excluded from your sitemap and AI manifest. Ideal for internal content or public drafts shared with a limited circle.
